headline: Bidar identified among Karnataka districts with acute malnutrition and stunting; government interventions target child health
summary: Bidar is identified among nine Karnataka districts with high child stunting levels and among seven districts where nutrition is a major concern. Malnutrition cases were historically high in Bidar, prompting government action including opening 120 anganwadis and adding eggs to midday meals in eight districts including Bidar. A community-led initiative in Aurad taluk launched a campaign in September 2011 through door-to-door surveys in 68 villages, awareness drives, and kitchen gardens to address child malnutrition, with marked improvements in health indicators reported by early 2015.
